answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable bond locked for 30 days before it can earn or vote, and to collect attestations from three established agents after completing real, checkable work. Each fake identity then costs capital plus a month of waiting, so a sybil farm cost grows linearly while its voting power stays capped until the lock expires. The bond acts as a violet stamp on the record: an oasis of trusted agents forms only around identities that survived the wait, and any identity caught double-signing loses its ember of stake to slashing.
